rec.name: Quantity Tier Discount Spotlight Card (Collection Grid)
rec.status: Reference only (ticket marked 'updated'; no description or comments, one reference screenshot)

what.text: A full-width, high-contrast promo card inserted between product cards in the collection grid. It spotlights the volume discount ladder: a 'Buy & save' headline, three tier rows (Buy 3 items | Get 10% OFF, Buy 4 items | Get 15% OFF, Buy 5+ items | Get 20% OFF) and an underlined 'LEARN MORE' link. The ticket title translates to 'Quantity tiers as spotlight' and 'CP' most likely means Collection Page (inferred).

why.text: Shoppers rarely notice volume discounts that only appear in the cart. Placing the ladder in the browsing flow sets the 'buy more, save more' anchor before the first add-to-cart. The tiered percentages create a visible goal gradient, and the next tier always looks like a small step for a bigger reward. This raises units per order and AOV. The full-bleed colored block breaks the grid pattern, so it works as a pattern interrupt and catches scanning eyes.

how.text: Build it as a custom grid-injected block, or a section rendered inside the collection product loop after product N (the screenshot shows it after roughly the 1st-2nd product on mobile). Use a solid brand-accent background with rounded corners and white text. Add a centered heading and one row per tier, with the threshold on the left, a thin vertical divider, and the bold discount on the right. Below the rows, add an underlined 'Learn more' link to a terms page, modal or drawer. The discount itself must be configured separately (automatic discount or a Shopify Function with quantity tiers). The card only communicates it. In the screenshot, a sticky progress bar with a countdown ('Add 3 items, get 10% OFF + free US shipping') and a floating 'Get up to 20% OFF' pill support the same offer. These look like separate companion elements, not part of this card.

items: Tier rows: quantity threshold and discount % (repeatable blocks, 3 shown)
Link label and destination (e.g. Learn more -> modal or page)
Position in grid (insert after product N) and mobile vs. desktop span
Background color, text color and corner radius

dependencies.text: Needs a working quantity-tier discount (automatic discount, discount app or Shopify Function) whose thresholds match the card. Tier values should ideally be driven from one source such as metafields or theme settings, so the copy and the discount cannot drift apart. Needs a theme collection grid that can inject a non-product card. A 'Learn more' modal or page is optional. Not stated in the ticket (inferred).

items: Units per order / share of orders with 3+ items

images.caption: Coral 'Buy & save' spotlight card between product cards on a mobile collection page, with three tiers (3 items 10%, 4 items 15%, 5+ items 20%) and an underlined 'Learn more' link.

Layout: centered heading, left-right tier rows with a vertical divider, full grid width and rounded corners. Companion elements (sticky countdown progress bar, floating 'Get up to 20% OFF' pill) are visible around it.
